data.title: Machi Expands Long Positions to $131 Million as Market Rises
data.description: On-chain analyst Lookonchain said well-known trader Machi has continued adding to long positions as the market rises, bringing his total long exposure to $131 million. According to ChainCatcher, the positions include 32,600 ETH with a liquidation price of $2,517, 495 BTC with a liquidation price of $73,501, and 55,500 HYPE with a liquidation price of $18.7.

data.title: VanEck Rates Metaplanet 'Bad' On Executive Compensation
data.description: VanEck rated Metaplanet “Bad” on executive compensation, making it the only one of the 10 largest digital asset treasuries to receive that grade and saying it failed all four of its tests. The research note landed on September 18, according to BeInCrypto, even after Metaplanet cut its executive option pool twice in the past month. Metaplanet, a Tokyo-listed company holding 43,000 Bitcoin (BTC), has seen its share count rise from 153.9 million to roughly 1.35 billion in two years.

data.title: Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer Says Bitcoin's New Four-Year Bull Cycle May Have Started
data.description:
Fidelity Investments Global Macro Director Jurrien Timmer said Bitcoin began moving higher after consolidating near the $60,000 support zone for nearly a year, a period he said is comparable to a typical Bitcoin winter. According to ChainCatcher, Timmer said this suggests a new four-year cycle bull market may already be underway.

Timmer also said the BTC-gold Z-score has moved from -100% to positive territory, a signal that has historically confirmed a bottom. He added that the current environment reflects a new long-term regime with higher capital costs, and that governments may respond with financial repression.

data.title: Anthropic Targets November IPO Window As It Weighs New Model Launch
data.description: Anthropic is targeting a November IPO window as it weighs whether to ship a new model before its roadshow, with the timing and product decision seen as key to pricing what could be the largest listing ever. according to BeInCrypto, the Wall Street Journal said the company is aiming later than the October debut investors expected, while Reuters reported the listing could slip past the November midterm elections. The New York Times said offering documents could be released within weeks.

data.title: Jiang Zhuoer Says Crypto Trading Profit Reached 92% in U-Settled Terms
data.description:
LaiBit mining pool founder Jiang Zhuoer said his crypto trading profit reached 34% in coin-denominated terms after several months of trading, while U-settled profit has reached 92%, close to doubling. According to ChainCatcher, he said the key to profitability is position sizing, trading, and asset selection.

Jiang said market sentiment must be incorporated into trading and described the current market as a bull cycle. He said his default personal position is fully allocated to spot ETH, and that recent short positions were mainly used as protection for spot holdings after price gains, helping reduce downside drawdowns.

data.title: Saudi Arabia Seeks Rare Israeli Support as Hormuz Strait Is Effectively Blocked
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Saudi Arabia is seeking support from Israel, which it has not established diplomatic relations with, to avoid disruptions to oil supplies after the Strait of Hormuz was effectively blocked and an alternative pipeline was damaged in attacks by pro-Iran armed groups.

data.title: Matrix Raises $6.5 Million in Funding Round
data.description:
Matrix has completed a $6.5 million funding round, with AC Capital and UZ Capital among the investors. According to ChainCatcher, Matrix is an Unstoppable Execution Rollup built on BNB Chain L1.

The project says it uses the Facet technology stack to rebuild and adapt to PoSA consensus, while inheriting BNB ordering, data availability, and finality through an independent high-performance execution environment.

data.title: IG Holds 54% Chance to Beat JDG in LPL Qualifier Prediction Event
data.description:
In predict.fun’s prediction event for the LPL qualifier match between IG and JDG, IG’s chance of defeating JDG is currently 54%. According to Odaily, the two teams will meet at 5 p.m. in the final match of the 2026 Global Finals LPL qualifier, a best-of-five series.

The winner will become the LPL’s fourth seed and secure the region’s final World Championship berth, while the loser will end its season and miss the 2026 Global Finals. IG lost 1-3 to TES in the first round of the qualifier, while JDG beat WE 3-1 in an elimination match yesterday.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Europe’s Winter Power Surge Is Largest Since Energy Crisis
data.description: Europe’s electricity markets are flashing their strongest warning since the energy crisis as the region heads into winter, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Anduril Founder Says Trump’s Taiwan Arms Delay Is Hurting Business
data.description: According to CNBC, Anduril founder Palmer Luckey said President Donald Trump’s delay in approving a $14 billion arms package for Taiwan is affecting the defense tech company’s business, and that he has discussed the issue with Trump. Speaking to reporters in Taipei, where he attended a defense forum with Taiwan President Lai Ching-te, Luckey said he did not know the status of the package and added that Anduril’s business with Taiwan would be in a different position if the deal moved forward. He said he had also raised the matter with Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and warned that delaying the package could have broader, longer-lasting effects. Anduril’s Altius drone is used by Taiwan, and last year Taiwan unveiled its first missile jointly made with a U.S. company, Anduril’s Barracuda-500.

data.title: Vietnam Plans First Crypto Asset Licenses Under Pilot Framework in 2026
data.description:
Vietnam plans to issue licenses to its first crypto asset service providers in 2026 under a pilot legal framework and allow the first digital asset platforms to begin operating. According to ChainCatcher, Vietnam's Deputy Minister of Finance Nguyen Duc Chi met with Mariana Kuhnel, Executive Director of Austria's Financial Market Authority, in Vienna to discuss bilateral cooperation and the exchange of financial regulatory experience.

Vietnam National Securities Commission Chair Vu Thi Chan Phuong said the regulatory mechanism will cover service providers and investor transactions, with a focus on risk management, investor asset protection, and anti-money laundering. Kuhnel proposed that the two sides hold an online technical seminar and strengthen coordination through the International Organization of Securities Commissions.

data.title: AI TRENDS | SlowMist Warns FomoPeek App Contains Malicious Code in Versions 1.1-1.2
data.description:
SlowMist issued a security alert after receiving multiple reports of stolen user assets linked to FomoPeek. According to Foresight News, a joint investigation with OKX's security team found that some affected users had previously installed or used FomoPeek versions 1.1-1.2, which contained malicious code.

SlowMist said FomoPeek included modules unrelated to normal business operations, including one with a kernel exploit framework for iOS. The framework supports eight attack methods and can automatically choose an exploit based on device model and iOS version. Affected systems include iOS 12.0 to 18.7 and iOS 26.0 to 26.1. If successful, the app may bypass the iOS sandbox and access and decrypt Keychain data, exposing private keys, seed phrases, login credentials and other sensitive files. SlowMist also said FomoPeek connected to hidden servers unrelated to its public services and could receive remote commands.

SlowMist said plaintext traffic captured in its analysis showed the attack functions are currently enabled and run automatically at regular intervals. It advised users who installed or used FomoPeek versions 1.1-1.2 to check for abnormal asset activity, generate new private keys and seed phrases on a trusted device that has never installed the app, transfer assets to a new account as soon as possible, update to the latest iOS version, and avoid continuing to use or reinstall FomoPeek.

data.title: Hong Kong Plans Tokenized FX Fund Notes Trial by End-2026
data.description:
Hong Kong Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said digital assets and fintech are a new growth engine for the city, and digital bonds issued in Hong Kong account for about 50% of the global market. According to ChainCatcher, Hong Kong plans to trial tokenization of Exchange Fund Bills by the end of 2026 and to build a digital asset platform at CMU in 2026 to provide one-stop services for digital bond issuance and settlement.

The city also plans to improve its virtual asset licensing regime, strengthen the regulatory framework for tokenized investment products, promote trading of regulated stablecoins on licensed platforms, and encourage broader use cases for compliant stablecoins.

data.title: RISEx Offers XLP Vault Attacker 20% of Stolen Funds If 80% Is Returned by September 23
data.description:
Decentralized exchange RISEx sent an on-chain message to the attacker behind the XLP vault incident after seeing funds begin to move. According to Foresight News, the team said the attacker could keep 20%, or about 134,566 USDC, if the remaining 80%, or about 538,265 USDC or equivalent ETH, is returned to its official Ethereum or Base address by September 23, and the case would be handled as a white-hat hack.

Foresight News previously reported that RISEx said on August 4 that an unauthorized withdrawal occurred in its XLP vault-related RWA strategy, affecting 673,011.56 USDC.
